ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels covering approximately 80-85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips, resulting in a high macro-level contrast ratio at peripheral boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. Granular, high-contrast mottling is observed at the transition between the white tips and the dark central fluke body. The central 70% of the fluke surface is a solid low-intensity block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 45-55 degrees. The notch depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Edge topography consists of sharp peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels relative to the mean edge line. Serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral sweep characterized by a concave curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in a convex outer-lobe boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel spots (3-10 pixel diameter) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating heavy colonization or prior attachment scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical-oriented high-contrast linear streaks (~15-30 pixels in length) are detectable on the left lobe mid-surface, cutting through the low-intensity base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular scarring and potential minor tissue loss at the distal tips, evidenced by the jagged white-to-black intensity transitions and missing segments along the leading and trailing edges of the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A deep, irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, located approximately 30% of the distance from the tip to the median notch.
